title: Power Automate: export work queue items to CSV from the automation center
summary: Hold: the briefing casts doubt on Dataverse security roles governing access to exported work queue data, although Microsoft documents role-based protection for the automation center's underlying data. The roadmap facts and control paths are supported; the licensing model and the format of the REST call also need small corrections. All seven Learn pages flagged by the pre-check were successfully retrieved in this run.
